name: williams_r_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic momentum flows periodically push the index to the extreme of its 3-minute high-low range — Williams %R below -88 — accompanied by an elevated volume ratio, signaling a climax bar where aggressive sellers have cleared the near-side order book. At this point, passive buy orders resting below market begin absorbing remaining supply, and delta-neutral market makers short gamma (from ATM option selling) start hedging by buying NIFTY futures, creating a swift reversion toward mid-range. At 5-second resolution we capture the first 30-90 seconds of this rebound as Williams %R turns back from -90 toward -50, before the move dissipates into the session equilibrium. The VWAP proximity filter ensures we avoid entering during sustained institutional directional TWAP flows where the extreme can persist.
core_signal_oneliner: Williams %R(36) below -88 (3-minute range extreme) with 1.5x volume surge, VWAP proximity within 1.5%, and Williams %R slope already turning back over 15 seconds
